issue_request: FHIR-36837 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked Vocab to clarify CodeSystem.valueSet so that "entire code system" means all codes independent of code/concept status, with an immutable value set and validation support for allowed code compositions.
initial_application: The requested text was applied by git commit 27b184d04790893f6ff56757454031e29bf64ff9, which changed source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml from the old "entire code system" definition/comment to the current independent-of-status wording. The current active CodeSystem StructureDefinition still contains that resolved definition and comment.
additional_context: The Jira resolution explicitly depended on FHIR-36942, the same-day Published/Persuasive ValueSet.compose clarification that "all codes" means all codes defined by the code system independent of code status. source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml contains the matching rule. Vocab minutes for 2022-04-28 list FHIR-36837 and FHIR-36942 together for review/vote, and the archived Vocab policy on all-codes value sets repeats the CodeSystem.valueSet wording. Precise Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-36837 discussion or conflicting community direction.
reconciliation: No source change was made. CodeSystem is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml already matches the approved resolution for CodeSystem.valueSet. A generated-looking source/codesystem/codesystem.svg title still uses older "entire code system" wording, but it was not edited because the authoritative StructureDefinition source is correct and SVG-only changes are outside the source-fix threshold.
